observed_evidence.source: connected GitHub main + Windsor Search Console and GA4 + canonical Supabase

root_cause: Homepage JSON-LD modeled four unrelated destinations as one BreadcrumbList and advertised €1495-€4995 AggregateOffer despite currently visible €99/€299/€749 subscription prices. Structured claims should describe the actual page and visible offer.
fix: Remove only the incorrect homepage BreadcrumbList node and stale SoftwareApplication AggregateOffer. Preserve all real entities, canonical, visible copy, links, analytics and consent.
prevention_rule: Homepage structured data must not model sibling pages as breadcrumb ancestors or emit offer prices inconsistent with the currently visible commercial price page; fail closed until price basis is confirmed.
target_metric: JSON-LD validity and visible content parity; monitor GSC clicks/impressions and GA4 qualified CTA; do not infer ranking lift
rollback_condition: Missing legitimate schema entities, broken JSON-LD, failed i18n/website regressions, or production mismatch
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required and CodeQL, protected merge, exact production SHA and public HTML JSON-LD readback, Brain outcome writeback
